items.description: Capri — Free open-source AI desktop pet, gaming overlay & voice companion for Windows. Visual GUI for Claude Code, Ollama, DeepSeek & MCP. Joins Discord calls, launches Steam games, comments on gameplay & automates screen tasks offline.
items.readme:
# Capri AI — Cyberpunk Desktop Pet, Gaming Overlay & Voice Companion for Windows **Capri AI Desktop** turns your Windows 10/11 screen into an interactive cyberpunk workspace. Instead of staring at a dark terminal, you get a visual desktop pet and AI operator that perches on your windows, talks in 80 languages, joins Discord voice calls, and automates tasks through **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Ollama**, **DeepSeek**, and **MCP servers**.

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/edgerunners2/capri-ai-desktop?style=for-the-badge&color=ff003c&labelColor=0a0a12)](https://github.com/edgerunners2/capri-ai-desktop/releases/latest) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/edgerunners2/capri-ai-desktop?style=for-the-badge&color=00f0ff&labelColor=0a0a12)](https://github.com/edgerunners2/capri-ai-desktop/stargazers) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-00f0ff?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0a0a12&label=platform)

**[Features](#features)** · **[Quick Start](#quick-start)** · **[What You Can Ask](#what-you-can-ask)** · **[How It Works](#how-it-works)** · **[Roadmap](#roadmap)** · **[FAQ](#faq)**
## Quick Start ### 1. Download Capri is currently available for **Windows** as a portable build: | Format | Download | Best for | |---|---|---| | **Portable** | [`Capri-Portable.zip`](https://github.com/edgerunners2/capri-ai-desktop/releases/download/v3.9.1/Capri-Portable-3.9.1.zip) | Running Capri from any folder, no installation needed | Requires Windows 10 or newer. macOS and Linux versions are on the [roadmap](#roadmap). ### 2. Install and launch - **Portable:** put the portable build in any folder and run it. No installation needed. ### 3. Connect your AI On first launch, Capri asks which assistant to use. Sign in to your account or paste your API key for **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Antigravity** or another supported assistant. --- ## Design & Aesthetic Capri takes visual cues from *Cyberpunk: Edgerunners* and classic netrunner interfaces. Instead of a standard utility window, you get a compact HUD character that lives directly on your desktop. - **Visual style:** High-contrast crimson and cyan accents over matte black, angular frames, and subtle glitch transitions. - **Direct execution:** You state the task in plain text or voice, and the agent handles the clicks, files, and commands. - **Local control:** Built to stay out of the way until called, with an immediate kill-switch (`Esc`) whenever she is automating your cursor. --- ## Core Capabilities - **Voice and text chat:** Talk to her directly or enable the `"Hey Capri"` wake word. She replies naturally across 80 languages. - **Custom voice synthesis:** Use her built-in offline voice, load your own local voice model, or connect Fish Audio, ElevenLabs, or OpenAI. See [Her voice](#her-voice). - **Gaming overlay:** She watches your screen while you play, reacts to events in real time, and has experimental support for basic game inputs. - **Desktop automation:** She launches programs, controls media, closes browser tabs, and navigates UI workflows using her own cursor. Interrupt her mid-action anytime by speaking or pressing `Esc`. - **Local memory:** Conversation logs and screen context stay stored locally on your drive. - **Window perching:** She sits on top of active windows, reacts to system audio rhythms, or docks neatly along the edge of your screen. - **Mini media player:** Includes a compact Windows playback widget with Capri perched right on top.

Her mini player
Talking to her
The Mainframe

Voice Call Integration
Real footage, sped up in places. Other people's names and avatars and the server are cropped out or blurred. Tell her to hop into your Discord channel and relay a message—for example: *"Hey Capri, join the call, tell them I'll be back in 15 minutes, and boot up whatever they're playing."* - **Autonomous channel joining:** She locates and clicks the Join Voice button herself, then updates your party with a custom excuse while you are AFK. - **Game and media launching:** If friends in the call request a specific Steam game or track, she can launch it on your machine. - **Multi-app support:** Beyond Discord, call mode works with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Signal, Skype, TeamSpeak, Mumble, Steam Voice, and browser-based calls. Select a target under `VOICE > Call app` or leave it on Auto. - **Live call UI:** Displays active voice rings for each speaker, real-time speech captions, a quick hang-up button, and a compact floating pill when minimized. - **Speaker separation:** Distinguishes your voice from incoming call audio—only your voice triggers the wake word or approves actions, preventing Discord audio bleed from hijacking commands. - **Friend command gating:** By default, requests coming from other people in the call require your explicit confirmation via mic or keyboard (`SECURITY` toggle). - **Natural interruption handling:** Continues speaking through brief laughs or backchannels, but pauses immediately if someone speaks over her for more than a second. - **Virtual mic routing:** Route her voice into your call via `Settings > VOICE > Her voice in your mic` using `CABLE Output` or `Steam Streaming Microphone`. Audio routing stays active only during calls and includes a dedicated gain slider. Call mode is currently a Windows-only beta feature. Ask her to join a call to activate it, or toggle **Call mode (beta)** in the chat input bar. If she stops after a single sentence on Discord, disable Discord's built-in **Echo Cancellation** and **Noise Suppression**.

Modding & Customization


 Open **Mods** from the CAPRI bar inside the Mainframe to browse the [mods directory](https://github.com/edgerunners2/capri-mods). You can preview, download, install with one click, import local packages, or submit your own. **Nine starter mods included (by Vocyn):** four color schemes (Bubblegum, Cyber Cyan, Royal, and Toxic), Custom Names, Sharper Ears, Hearing Log, Hello Code, and Startup Intros.


Startup Intros. Say "intro shatter" to lock one in, or "intro shuffle" to mix them up.

- **Config mods (`.capri-mod`) and skins (`.capri-skin`):** Config mods adjust behavior parameters, while skins alter her appearance. Skins support layering—enable multiple outfits or accessories (like cat ears) at the same time. - **Scripted code mods (`.capri-code`):** Execute custom logic on your machine. Capri prompts you for permission before running a code mod for the first time or after any file modification, listing all requested hooks (chat, voice, memory, hotkeys, idle triggers). Check [mods/MODDING.md](mods/MODDING.md) for documentation. - Every submission in the official directory undergoes malware screening before listing. - **Built-in color editor:** Adjust Hair, Accents, Eyes, Edges, or Body colors directly on the Mods tab and export the result as a shareable `My Colors` package. - **Publishing:** Fork [capri-mods](https://github.com/edgerunners2/capri-mods), add a directory containing your mod file, a `README`, and a `preview.png`, then submit a pull request.
--- ## Example Prompts | Command | Execution | |---|---| | *"Join the Discord call, tell them I'm grabbing coffee, and launch Cyberpunk 2077."* | Clicks into the voice channel, relays the message to your party, and boots the game via Steam. | | *"Close Chrome and heavy background apps so I can play."* | Identifies memory-heavy processes, asks for confirmation, and clears system resources. | | *"Clip the last minute of gameplay or check what's killing my FPS."* | Triggers your capture hotkey or inspects active background processes hogging GPU/CPU. | | *"Sort my Downloads folder into subfolders by file extension."* | Scans the directory, outlines the file structure, and moves files once you confirm. | | *"Locate the bug in this repository and patch it."* | Inspects project files, isolates the error, applies a fix, and runs verification checks. | | *"Merge all PDFs in this directory into a single summary."* | Parses each document and compiles a unified overview file. | | *"Back up my Documents folder every Monday morning."* | Registers a scheduled recurring workflow for the directory. | --- ## How It Works ```mermaid flowchart LR U([You]) -->|plain language| C[Capri Desktop] C --> R{Engine Router} R --> E1[Claude Code] R --> E2[Codex] R --> E3[Antigravity] R --> E4[Any other assistant] C --> T[Tool Layer] T --> F[Files and projects] T --> S[Shell and apps] T --> W[Web] C --> G[Approval Gate] G -->|you confirm| T classDef neon fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#ff003c,color:#00f0ff,stroke-width:2px; class C,R,T,G neon; ``` 1. **You describe the goal** in plain language. 2. **Capri routes it** to the AI engine you selected. 3. **The engine plans the steps** and asks Capri to use tools. 4. **You approve sensitive actions**, and Capri carries them out on your desktop. ### Supported engines | Engine | Status | |---|:---:| | Claude Code | ✅ Supported | | Codex | ✅ Supported | | Antigravity | ✅ Supported | | Other assistants | 🧩 Via custom adapter | --- ## Configuration ```yaml # Example config engine: claude-code # claude-code | codex | antigravity | custom permissions: mode: ask # ask before acting | auto | read-only allowed_folders: - ~/Documents - ~/Projects interface: theme: cyberpunk ``` --- ## Safety An agent that works on your desktop is powerful, so treat it with care: - **Review before you approve.** Read what Capri is about to do, especially for deleting, moving or overwriting files. - **Limit the scope.** Give Capri access only to the folders it needs. - **Keep backups.** Back up important data before running large automated tasks. - **Protect your keys.** Never share your API keys or account tokens with anyone. --- ## Roadmap - [x] Windows app ( portable) - [x] Multiple AI engines - [x] Voice control - [ ] macOS version - [ ] Linux version - [ ] Plugin system - [ ] Task scheduler - [ ] Mobile companion - [ ] Community cyberpunk theme gallery Have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/edgerunners2/capri-ai-desktop/issues/new) and tell us what Capri should learn next. --- ## ❓ FAQ
Does Capri work on macOS or Linux?
Not yet. Capri is currently available for Windows as a portable build (`.zip`). macOS and Linux versions are planned, so star the repository to follow the progress.
Do I need to know how to code?
No. Download the app, connect your AI and describe what you need in plain language.
Which AI assistants does Capri support?
Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity out of the box, plus other assistants through custom adapters.
Is it safe to let an AI control my desktop?
Capri is designed so you can review actions before they run, but no tool is risk-free. Limit folder access, keep backups and read the [Safety](#%EF%B8%8F-safety) section.
Where does my data go?
Your requests are processed by the AI assistant you connect, under that provider's terms and privacy policy.
Is Capri an official Cyberpunk or Edgerunners product?
No. Capri is an independent, unofficial fan project with a cyberpunk aesthetic, inspired by *Cyberpunk: Edgerunners*. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by CD PROJEKT RED, Studio Trigger, Netflix or any other rights holder.
--- ## Quick Troubleshooting If you encounter any issues while running Capri AI, check these quick fixes before opening an issue: ### 1. Local Ollama / LLaMA Models Disconnecting * **Why it happens:** Host connection timeout or missing CORS headers in your local setup. * **Fix:** Make sure Ollama is running in the background before launching Capri. If you are using a custom port, update the `allowed_folders` and server URL inside your `config.yaml`. ### 2. Voice Chat or Audio Input Lag * **Why it happens:** Discord, Teams, or Zoom background noise suppression conflicting with Qwen3-ASR. * **Fix:** Go to your voice app settings (e.g., Discord Audio Settings) and temporarily disable **Echo Cancellation** and **Krisp/Noise Suppression**. Let Capri handle the voice gating. --- ## Supported Workflows & Alternatives Capri Desktop acts as a free, open-source, local-first alternative and wrapper for: - **Anthropic Claude Code** (Provides a beautiful desktop Cyberpunk GUI instead of a dark terminal) - **DeepSeek-V3 / DeepSeek-R1 Native Client** (Run ultra-cheap API routing on your Windows desktop) - **Open-Interpreter & Desktop-Agent alternatives** (Full mouse and keyboard automation layer) - **Ollama / LLaMA.cpp Desktop Companion** (100% local offline AI Waifu execution) --- ## Documentation & Guides - **[Local AI & Ollama Setup](docs/OLLAMA_SETUP.md)** — Run DeepSeek-R1, Qwen, and Llama models 100% offline. - **[Discord Call Mode Guide](docs/DISCORD_CALL_MODE.md)** — Virtual microphone routing and voice chat setup for Windows. - **[Roadmap & Platform Ports](../../issues)** — Track progress for macOS, Linux, and custom `.capri-skin` modding. ---
**If Capri saves you time, drop a ⭐ and share it with a friend.** *Stay sharp, edgerunner.*

# 🕹️ Spaceship IDE

Steer your ideas in realtime, space pilot style!

![Screencast](./extra/screencast.gif)

## Demos

Watch on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reels/DfyQPhFtW-z/) and [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3WmNLWUmcnY). You can try the simulator at [https://chuanqisun.github.io/spaceship/](https://chuanqisun.github.io/spaceship/) with the option to go live with your API keys for Cerebras and Gemini. Keys stay in your browser local storage. Do it at your own risk.

## Conjecture

> In the near future, LLM and Decision Models will reach 60 FPS interactivity.

When that happens, what new interaction paradigms will unlock? This project demonstrates plausible and desirable interactions for that future.

1. **Focus monitor**: can we visualize what LLM is paying attention to, and use that to guide human's focus towards what's important?

   ![focus monitor](./extra/clips/focus-monitor.gif)

2. **Attention lock**: can we force LLM to pay more attention to specific phrases so as to bias its future behavior?

   ![attention lock](./extra/clips/attention-lock.gif)

3. **Future Vector Steering**: can we decompose the task into eigenvectors, independently tune each, and re-compose them to influence the incoming text?

   ![future steering](./extra/clips/future-steering.gif)

4. **Realtime re-generation**: when text generation is cheap and fast, can we explore alternative futures by scrubbing?

   ![realtime regeneration](./extra/clips/realtime-regeneration.gif)

## Design process

I used Claude Code for most of the implementation but stayed hands-on for the UI/UX. I iterate using interactive style swatch, a technique where I prompt AI to give me diverse options of designs, I provide feedback, and it iterates. You can see the design artifacts in the [extra page](https://chuanqisun.github.io/spaceship/extra/style-1.html).

To achieve the realtime experience, I have to use agreesive speculative generation and manage cache invalidation based on user interactions. For example, when the main knob moves backward, I have to empty future texts and cancel ongoing requests. There are many considerations like this throughout the system and that took a lot of human judgement - claude didn't one shot them.

## Theory

I'm currently focusing on systems that help human shape ideas in realtime. This project is a small step towards my [upcoming thesis](https://code.chuanqisun.com/master-thesis/) at the MIT Media Lab, where I investigate how semantic and symoblic systems can be coupled to enhance human creativity, agency, and joy of craft.

## Citation

If you build on this work, please cite it as:

```bibtex
@misc{sun2026spaceship,
  author       = {Sun, Chuanqi},
  title        = {Spaceship {IDE}: Steer Your Ideas in Realtime, Space Pilot Style},
  year         = {2026},
  publisher    = {GitHub},
  howpublished = {\url{https://github.com/chuanqisun/spaceship}},
  note         = {Demo: \url{https://chuanqisun.github.io/spaceship/}}
}
```

# MATE Wayland Desktop A Linux distribution built around the two-panel MATE desktop, the continuation of GNOME 2, running on Wayland. MATE's panel, menus, file manager and settings run on the [labwc](https://labwc.github.io/) compositor in place of MATE's X11-only window manager. The source is the whole project: the session, the settings, the package builds, the artwork, and the build system that produces the live, installable ISO. > An independent project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the MATE or > GNOME projects, or by Canonical. Based on Ubuntu.

## Get it Download the ISO, with its checksum and the installation steps, from . Guides for NVIDIA graphics and for screens and scaling are at . ## What you get - The classic layout: Applications, Places and System menus, notification area, battery, volume and clock at the top; window list and workspace switcher at the bottom; desktop icons. - Caja file manager, MATE Control Center, Firefox with uBlock Origin. - Menta theme, Noto Sans, Yaru icons, the project's own wallpaper, logo, login screen, lock screen and boot splash. - Multiple monitors, each at its own resolution, with the wallpaper on all. - A live ISO for USB or DVD (UEFI) with the Calamares installer and optional disk encryption (LUKS2; `/boot` stays unencrypted, as with Ubuntu's own installer). ## Technical summary | | | |---|---| | Base | Ubuntu 26.04 LTS packages, Linux 7.0, no GNOME Shell, no snap | | Display | Wayland, labwc 0.9 (wlroots); XWayland for X11-only programs | | Desktop | MATE 1.29: panel, Caja, Control Center, settings daemon, media; mate-applets 1.28 | | Login / installer | LightDM, Calamares 3.3 (LUKS2 option) | | Wayland tools | gtklock, swayidle, grim, slurp, satty, wdisplays, kanshi, wlr-randr | | Browser | Firefox from Mozilla's APT repository | ## Build it On a Debian-family Linux machine with `debootstrap`, `apt` and `sudo` (nothing is installed on the build machine): ```sh ./build.sh --packages # first time: build the MATE packages, then the ISO ./build.sh # afterwards: just the ISO ``` The ISO is written to `iso/out/`. The first build from an empty clone takes about 35 minutes (it downloads everything). After that a full ISO rebuild takes about 8 minutes, and a rebuild after changing only this project's own files about a minute. ## NVIDIA graphics The ISO starts every machine on the open drivers that come with the kernel. For an NVIDIA card that is `nouveau`, which shows a picture but cannot do GPU computing (CUDA, OpenCL). NVIDIA's own driver is installed after the system is installed, with a tool that is already on it. You need an internet connection. **1. See which card you have and which driver is recommended** ```sh sudo apt update ubuntu-drivers devices ``` Look for the line ending in `recommended`, for example `nvidia-driver-595-open - distro non-free recommended`. ("open" is about the kernel part of the driver only; CUDA and OpenCL are the same in both kinds.) **2. Install it** ```sh sudo ubuntu-drivers install ``` That installs the recommended driver. To choose one yourself, name it: `sudo ubuntu-drivers install nvidia:595-open`. It takes a few minutes and switches off `nouveau`. On a laptop with two graphics cards it selects the "on-demand" mode: the built-in card draws the desktop and the NVIDIA card is used by programs that ask for it. **3. Restart the computer** **4. Check that it works** ```sh nvidia-smi ``` It should show your card and the driver version. If the desktop looks normal and `~/.local/state/mate-wayland-desktop/labwc-software.log` does not exist, the desktop is running with graphics acceleration. **GPU computing, for example hashcat** ```sh sudo apt install hashcat hashcat -I # lists the card hashcat -b -m 0 # a short benchmark ``` hashcat says "CUDA SDK Toolkit not installed" and continues with OpenCL, which works. **If the desktop does not start after the restart** Press Ctrl+Alt+F3, log in with your user name and password, and remove the driver: ```sh sudo apt purge '*nvidia*' sudo reboot ``` The system is then back on `nouveau`. ## Documentation Guides and downloads are on the project's website, . `CUSTOMISATIONS.md` in the source lists every difference from stock Ubuntu and MATE, and why. ## Reporting problems and contributing Problems and suggestions: . How to report, build and send changes is in `CONTRIBUTING.md`; security problems are reported privately, see `SECURITY.md`. ## Credits Built on the work of the [MATE](https://mate-desktop.org/) project, the [labwc](https://labwc.github.io/) compositor, [Ubuntu](https://ubuntu.com/) and the Yaru icon theme. Fixes to upstream components are meant to go back upstream. ## Licence GPL-3.0; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Components taken from other projects keep their own licences.

# Boring Marketing Skills

Free marketing skills for your AI agent: research, positioning, copy, pages, SEO, AI search, ads, email and content, plus a deep pack for local businesses and the people who market them.

32 skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. They were built from real campaigns, and every one works without a paid tool. MIT licensed.

Made by James Dickerson ([@boringmarketer](https://x.com/boringmarketer)). More at [boringmarketing.com](https://boringmarketing.com). Need clients to use this on? [boringfunnels.com](https://boringfunnels.com) finds local businesses losing customers (I make it). Want agents built for your team? [Work with us](https://boringmarketing.com/#work).

## Install

Any agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others):

```bash
npx skills add boringmarketer/boring-marketing-skills
```

Claude Code plugin:

```
/plugin marketplace add boringmarketer/boring-marketing-skills
/plugin install boring-marketing@boring-marketing-skills
```

Then type `/start-here` and name the business. It reads the site and the reviews, writes the brand files every other skill uses, and tells you which skill to run next. The first run takes about 3 minutes.

## The skills

Grouped by stage, in the order a customer meets a business.

### Start here

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `start-here` | Reads the business (yours or a client's), writes the brand files, and routes you to the next skill |
| `brand-voice` | Pulls the voice from the site and reviews so every page and post sounds like the business |
| `positioning-angles` | Finds the angle and the offer that make them the obvious call |
| `audience-research` | Reads reviews, forums and competitors for the words customers actually use |
| `competitive-intel` | Sizes up the rivals that show up first, including what their customers complain about |

### Get found

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `google-business-profile` | Checks the Google profile against the top 3 in the map pack and writes a month of posts |
| `local-seo-plan` | Decides which services and towns get a page, which get a section, and which to skip |
| `service-area-pages` | Writes town and service pages that aren't the same page with the city swapped |
| `ai-search` | Checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI name the business, and what to fix if they don't |
| `site-audit` | Crawls the site like Google and the AI crawlers do and ranks the few technical fixes that stop it being found |
| `keyword-research` | Maps what people search, from free autocomplete data, as topics instead of a 5,000-row list |
| `seo-content` | Writes the articles and guides that answer those searches |
| `programmatic-seo` | Builds many pages from one template and a data set, without thin pages |

### Get chosen

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `reviews` | Finds where reviews stall, writes the owner replies, and sets up the ask after every job |
| `first-screen-check` | Looks at the site on a phone the way a customer does: is the number, the promise and the proof on the first screen? |
| `landing-page` | Builds a page for one service and one offer, phone first |
| `direct-response-copy` | Writes headlines, offers and pages that get the call |
| `lead-magnet` | Makes the checklist, quote calculator or guide people trade an email for |

### Get the call

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `paid-ads` | Writes Google and Meta ads and the test plan for them |
| `google-ads-tracking` | Makes Google Ads count calls and form fills, so it bids on real leads |
| `ads-incrementality-check` | Runs a pause test against the phone log to see if the ads make the phone ring or only take credit |
| `meta-ads` | Sets up the Meta API, launches the campaign and proves the tracking fires |
| `speed-to-lead` | Finds missed calls and slow replies, then sets up the text-back and follow-up |
| `creative` | Makes ad images and short videos with AI image and video models |

### Bring them back

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `email-sequences` | Writes the welcome, quote follow-up, review ask and seasonal emails |
| `newsletter` | Plans and writes a newsletter people open |
| `performance-review` | Reads the numbers each month and says what to keep, cut and test |

### Win clients (for agencies and freelancers)

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `find-local-clients` | Picks a trade and a town, then ranks the businesses losing the most customers |
| `pitch-the-fix` | Finds the owner and writes a short email about one thing that's broken, with a fix you can sell |

Every skill can keep a separate folder per client. Tell `/start-here` "new client" and it sets one up.

### Market yourself

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `social-content` | Writes posts from your own best posts, not generic hooks |
| `long-form-article` | Plans and drafts a long guide with real numbers and named sources |
| `content-atomizer` | Turns one piece into posts for every platform |

## Found in the work

These skills came out of real campaigns. Three of the findings behind them:

- **The promise isn't on the page.** Most local businesses running ads that promise 24/7 or same-day service don't say it on the first screen of the page the ad opens (hundreds of local sites checked on a phone, Nov 2026). That's `first-screen-check`.
- **The ads were taking credit.** Google credited a Performance Max campaign with most of an account's conversions. Paused, the phone log didn't move. That's `ads-incrementality-check`.
- **One campaign beat three.** On the same small budget, one broad campaign brought leads at a fraction of the cost of the same money split three ways by city. That's in `paid-ads`.

## What we use

Every skill works with your agent's own web access. When you want more, this is the stack we run, and each skill names the pick at the step where it helps, with the free way first.

| Job | What we use | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Web search for agents | Exa | Free tier, then pay as you go |
| Read, crawl and extract pages | Firecrawl | Free tier |
| Search volumes, SERPs, keyword data | DataForSEO | Pay as you go |
| Images and GIFs | GPT Image 2.6 (OpenAI) | Pay per image |
| Video | Seedance 2.5, through Higgsfield or Replicate | Pay per clip |
| Presenter and UGC-style ad video | Higgsfield Marketing Studio | Plans with credits |
| Voiceover | ElevenLabs | Free tier, then plans |
| Meta ads | Meta's official Ads MCP server and Ads CLI | Free with an ad account |
| Google Ads | Google Ads API | Free |
| Posting and scheduling | Zernio | Plans |
| Many data APIs, one key | treg | Pay per call |
| Search Console, Business Profile | Google | Free |
| Finding local businesses to pitch | boringfunnels (mine) | Free search, paid Pro |

Keys, setup and what each one unlocks: [TOOLS.md](TOOLS.md).

**About boringfunnels.** I make it, so every skill that mentions it says so on the same line. It never replaces the free path, and no skill needs it.

## Work with me

The skills are free. If you want more than the skills:

- **Have it built and run for you.** My team embeds with a few companies at a time and builds goal-tied AI agents that run their marketing. [boringmarketing.com](https://boringmarketing.com)
- **Learn to do it and sell it.** The [Boring Marketing community](https://www.skool.com/the-vibe-marketers) is where I teach marketers and agencies the whole playbook.
- **Find clients to use it on.** [boringfunnels.com](https://boringfunnels.com) finds local businesses losing customers (I make it).
- **Read the guides.** Long breakdowns on X at [@boringmarketer](https://x.com/boringmarketer).

## Updates

New skills land here first. Watch the repo to hear about them, and follow [@boringmarketer](https://x.com/boringmarketer) for the guides.

Found a bug or a skill that gave bad advice? Open an issue with what you asked and what it did.

## License

MIT. Use it for your business, your clients or your own product.

--- ## 项目概述 RegisterHub 是一个面向工程研发的现代化 Web 自动化框架，旨在彻底解决传统无头脚本在复杂前端交互中的脆弱性问题。框架基于 Playwright 运行时、OpenCV 离线计算机视觉算子及 Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) 架构构建，为现代单页应用 (SPA)、响应式受控表单以及自动化测试提供确定性的交互与状态编排能力。 ### 核心工程支柱 - **运行环境自洽性 (Runtime Environment Parity)**：通过原生 Chrome 二进制接入与底层自动化特征消除，保持 JavaScript 原型链纯净（`[native code]`），消除自动化标记对现代 Web 应用的异常干扰。 - **离线视觉算法求解器 (Algorithmic Vision Solver)**：内置双通 Canny 边缘轮廓计算与三次贝塞尔拟人手部动力学模型，纯本地离线执行，零第三方付费 API 依赖。 - **CDP 会话桥接架构 (CDP Bridge Architecture)**：深度支持外部指纹浏览器（AdsPower、比特浏览器等）与本地已登录 Chrome 会话无缝接入，复用既有干净住宅网络与登录状态。 - **AI 代理原生集成规范 (Agentic Co-Pilot Protocol)**：仓库根目录内置工业级 `AGENTS.md` 交互契约，深度适配 Cursor、Claude Code、Windsurf 与 Gemini CLI，支持 AI 自主嗅探表单、装配适配器并完成闭环验证。 --- ## 架构拓扑 ```text RegisterHub/ ├── core/ │ ├── adapter.py # 抽象适配器基类 (BaseSiteAdapter) 与生命周期契约 │ ├── pilot.py # 拟人按键动力学 (human_type) 与智能交互守门员 │ ├── stealth.py # 原生环境自洽引擎与 CDP 会话桥接器 │ ├── inspector.py # 启发式 DOM 表单探测器 (FormInspector) │ ├── solver.py # OpenCV 缺口匹配计算与贝塞尔轨迹规划器 │ ├── identity.py # 高熵多国身份与合规密码发生器 │ ├── mail_client.py # 毫秒级自适应退避邮箱轮询客户端 │ ├── runner.py # 调度引擎、黑匣子快照抓取与原子台账持久化 │ ├── scaffold.py # 适配器自动派生与预装配代码生成引擎 │ └── exporter.py # Bitwarden、1Password、CSV 及 JSON 资产导出器 ├── sites/ # 业务与示范适配器池 │ ├── _template.py # 工业级标准适配器实现模板 │ ├── demo_site.py # 自包含离线 Base64 靶场适配器 │ ├── quanticdata.py # OpenCV 拼图滑块与贝塞尔拖拽验证适配器 │ ├── deepgram.py # Deepgram $200 免费额度与 API Key 直出适配器 │ ├── amd.py # AMD AI 开发者计划官方注册适配器 │ ├── coarena.py # 谷歌登录后纯协议注册与提 Key 适配器 │ ├── milionseek.py # 100milionseek 每日 1 亿 Token 一键领 Key 与 Turnstile 穿透适配器 │ └── automation_exercise.py # 国际两步式向导交互基准适配器 ├── tests/ # 单元与回归自动化测试套件 ├── config.json # 全局浏览器运行配置 ├── pytest.ini # Pytest 测试隔离规范 ├── main.py # 统一命令行调度入口 ├── run.bat # Windows 交互引导脚本 (CRLF 规范) └── requirements.txt # 核心生产依赖清单 ``` --- ## 内置示范适配器矩阵 RegisterHub 开箱内置涵盖不同前端技术栈与复杂交互范式的经典实战适配器： | 适配器标识 | 目标应用 | 技术实现特性 | 核心评测与验证重点 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `demo` | 内置离线 Base64 靶场 | 零配置全离线管道 | 3 秒快速环境自洽性与生命周期端到端自检 | | `quanticdata` | Quantic Data 服务 | OpenCV 缺口识别 + 贝塞尔动力学 | 纯本地算子秒破拼图滑块挑战，零第三方打码依赖 | | `deepgram` | Deepgram 语音 AI 平台 | 谷歌人机主动穿透 + REST 协议闭环 | 官方赠送 $200 免费额度，100ms 原子直出 40 位 API Key | | `amd` | AMD AI 开发者计划 | Akamai 遥测自洽 + OneTrust 穿透 | 顶级大厂官方 AI 算力开发者计划注册与凭据获取 | | `coarena` | Coarena AI 平台 | **谷歌登录后纯协议注册与提 Key** | 示范 Google OAuth 会话捕获后 100% 协议确认条款并秒级直出 Key | | `milionseek` | 100milionseek 平台 | **每日 1 亿 Token 免费算力** + Turnstile 穿透 | 填邮箱秒级直出 Key（免收激活信），内置母号裂变接力管理 | | `automation_exercise` | 标准测试基准靶场 | 多阶段向导向注册流 | 复杂下拉联动与多选框状态硬断言 | --- ## 官方独立开箱即用衍生工程 (Standalone Showcase Ecosystem) > **矩阵互联与互相引流说明**： > 为了方便仅需针对**单一特定平台**进行自动化落地的开发者，本项目特将核心高频实战案例**全量解耦为 100% 自包含的独立 GitHub 开源工程**。 > 每个独立工程均自带 Windows 一键启动引导 `run.bat`、专属 `main.py` 调度入口与自包含运行底座，无需配置母港即可独立运行。你也可以直接在本主框架中通过 `python main.py --run ` 统一调度： | 独立开源项目 | 核心福利与架构亮点 | 独立工程直达 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **[Deepgram Register](https://github.com/waw666waw666/deepgram-register)** | 官方赠送 **$200 美元真金使用额度** + 谷歌 reCAPTCHA v2 主动穿透 + 纯 REST 协议秒级提 Key | [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/waw666waw666/deepgram-register) | | **[100MilionSeek Register](https://github.com/waw666waw666/100milionseek-register)** | **每天免费 1 亿 Tokens** + Turnstile 穿透 + 免收信页面卡片秒出 Key + 母号裂变接力 | [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/waw666waw666/100milionseek-register) | | **[AMD AI Dev Register](https://github.com/waw666waw666/amd-register)** | AMD 官方 AI 开发者计划注册 + Akamai 遥测自洽 + OneTrust 模态弹窗穿透 | [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/waw666waw666/amd-register) | | **[Coarena Register](https://github.com/waw666waw666/coarena-register)** | **谷歌登录后 100% 协议提 Key** + OAuth 会话捕获 + 条款签署与每日额度秒验 | [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/waw666waw666/coarena-register) | --- ## 快速上手 ### 1. 环境准备与依赖安装 ```bash # 克隆仓库 git clone https://github.com/waw666waw666/RegisterHub.git cd RegisterHub # 安装 Python 生产依赖 pip install -r requirements.txt # 安装 Playwright 浏览器内核 playwright install chromium ``` ### 2. 环境健康自检 检测宿主机运行环境、代理可用性以及依赖完整性： ```bash python main.py doctor ``` ### 3. 基线自测验证 执行内置离线靶场（无需外部网络或代理配置）： ```bash python main.py --run demo ``` 生成的凭据记录将自动以原子写入模式持久化至 `results/accounts.txt`。 ### 4. AI 助手协同使用指南 (Cursor / Claude Code / Windsurf / Gemini) 本项目为 AI 编程助手深度优化，仓库根目录自带专属 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 行为约束与 [SETUP_FOR_AI.md](SETUP_FOR_AI.md) 环境协议。 **前置操作**：使用你的 AI 编程客户端（如 Cursor、Windsurf、VS Code 搭配 Claude Code / Gemini CLI），将 **`RegisterHub` 项目文件夹作为工作区根目录打开**。 工作区载入后，支持通过以下两种方式让 AI 协助开发新站点的注册适配器： #### 方法一：极简直接丢（快捷交互模式） 直接在 AI 对话框中把目标网站注册地址发给 AI： ```text 请参考本项目规范与 AGENTS.md，为我编写该网站的自动化注册适配器：https://example.com/signup ``` AI 会自动读取根目录规则与模板，自主嗅探表单字段、生成代码骨架并尝试本地实测。 #### 方法二：人工自跑流程给步骤（强烈推荐，成号最稳健） 面对复杂的现代 Web 应用、多步向导或带交互验证的站点，**最稳健的做法是：你自己先在浏览器中手动注册成功一次**。 把你在真实操作中经历的**核心网址、点击按钮、表单字段、验证码类型及关键截图**直接发给 AI，例如： ```text 请参考本项目规范与 AGENTS.md，帮我把刚才手动跑通的注册流程写成自动化适配器： 目标网址：https://example.com/signup 我的手动操作步骤如下（附关键界面截图）： 1. 打开注册页，填入邮箱和密码，点击“Create Account”； 2. 页面弹出了 Cloudflare 人机验证框，手动点一下绿勾； 3. 去邮箱查收 6 位数字验证码，回填到页面的 OTP 输入框中； 4. 进入控制台仪表盘，点击右上角“API Keys”菜单，点击“Create New Key”； 5. 复制弹出的 sk-xxxx 密钥，完成流程。 请根据我的真实操作路径编写 sites/example_site.py，并进行本地试跑验收！ ``` AI 将直接对照你跑通的真实人类行为路径进行精确代码装配与接口逆向，避免无头盲测走弯路，一击必中！ --- ## 关于邮箱与验证码接收策略 (Email Strategies) 不同目标平台对注册邮箱的风控规则各异，RegisterHub 为开发者提供了三级透明收信策略： 1. **零收信门槛站点（即时秒出，新手首选）**： - 示范项目：`100milionseek` - **完全不需要接收任何验证码或激活信**！填入任意合规格式邮箱，过完 Turnstile 人机验证后，页面卡片 10 秒内直接渲染出明文 API Key。 2. **协议接管站点（OAuth 凭据换票）**： - 示范项目：`coarena` - 依托真机 Chrome 捕获 Google 登录态，浏览器仅充当瞬态取票器；会话捕获后 100% 纯协议签署条款、签发 API Key 并验活额度。 3. **需收码 / 高风控大额站点（如 Deepgram $200 美元真金赠金、AMD 开发者计划）**： - **默认方式（公网免费临时邮箱，全自动）**： 默认 `use_disposable_mail: true`，框架通过三通道公网接口（mail.tm 等）全自动接收 6 位验证码。适合轻量功能验证。 - **自备真实邮箱模式（强烈推荐，100% 成功保底）**： Deepgram、AMD 等官方大厂具备反欺诈黑名单库，公网部分免费临时域名可能被拦截。**强烈建议在 `config.json` 中填入自备的 Outlook / Hotmail / Gmail 个人邮箱**。脚本自动完成表单装配与人机穿透，并在终端提示输入验证码，回车即可 **100% 稳稳领走 $200 满额 API Key**！ - **工业级自建中枢（高级扩展）**： 支持开发者挂载自建 MailHub 容器池、Cloudflare Email Routing (Catch-all) 或 IMAP 协议，实现多通道批量无人值守收信。 --- ## 命令行接口 (CLI) ### 查看已装载适配器 列出所有已注册的适配器及其技术规格： ```bash python main.py --list ``` ### 自动化脚手架生成 输入目标网页 URL，自动嗅探 DOM 输入字段并生成类型完整的适配器骨架代码： ```bash # 智能探测目标网页并生成适配器代码 python main.py --scaffold target_service --url https://target-service.com/signup # 执行生成的新适配器 python main.py --run target_service ``` ### 外部指纹浏览器 CDP 桥接 直接附加至已在运行的外部指纹浏览器（AdsPower、比特浏览器）或开启调试端口的 Chrome 实例： ```bash python main.py --run demo --cdp http://127.0.0.1:9222 ``` ### 密码库资产标准导出 将测试产出的账号资产一键转换为标准格式： ```bash # 导出为 Bitwarden / 1Password 兼容 JSON python main.py export --export bitwarden # 导出为通用 CSV python main.py export --export csv # 导出为原始 JSON python main.py export --export json ``` --- ## AI 代理协作规范 (`AGENTS.md`) RegisterHub 针对自主编程智能体进行了全流程规范定义。根目录的 `AGENTS.md` 约束以下核心纪律： - **默认单并发纪律**：默认按单线程串行执行，避免无节制多开撕裂用户桌面；仅在单路稳定且等信占比超 50% 时主动提醒提速。 - **阶段守门员断言**：严禁无目的的时间等待 (`time.sleep`)，必须通过 URL 状态、DOM 属性或凭据落盘事实进行强校验。 - **宿主进程零干扰**：退出钩子严格基于明确的子进程树清理，严禁全局通杀系统进程，严禁全局抢占用户桌面焦点。 --- ## 测试套件执行 运行完整单元测试集以验证核心启发式探针、OpenCV 计算引擎与代码生成逻辑： ```bash pytest tests/ ``` --- ## 免责声明与开源协议 1. **开源许可证**：本项目基于标准的 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE) 许可协议发布。 2. **免责与合规说明**：本项目定位为**授权环境下的自动化流程走查与 Web 工程研究工具**。所有代码仅供技术交流与学术验证参考，完整法律声明与技术中立性说明请参阅： - [DISCLAIMER.zh.md](DISCLAIMER.zh.md) (中文版) - [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md) (English) --- ## 开发者社区与交流 如果你在账号工程自动化、协议逆向、云端风控自洽或 API Key 提取落地中有任何技术疑问、适配需求或交流想法，欢迎加入我们的开发者社群： - **QQ 交流群**：1130324020 - **Discord 社区**：[点击加入 Discord](https://discord.gg/USnVJ9YQX)

# Systems to AI: A Reading Map

**112 topics from 8 well-known engineering books, in a suggested reading order.**

From how a CPU runs your code, to operating systems, distributed data, system design, reliability, ML systems, and building and shipping LLMs.

Every topic below is a real chapter or section of its book.

## How to use this

- **Go in order.** Each stage builds on the one before it. Topic 1 is bits and bytes; topic 112 is shipping AI products.
- **One topic at a time.** Read the chapter, then explain it to someone (or write it down) without looking.
- **Start with what's free.** OSTEP and the Google SRE book are completely free online, by their authors. The LLM book's code is free on GitHub.
- **Buy or borrow the rest.** These books are worth owning. The links go to the official pages.

## The 8 books

| 1 | The Machine | [Computer Systems: A Programmer's Perspective](https://csapp.cs.cmu.edu/3e/about.html) (3rd ed.) | Randal E. Bryant, David R. O'Hallaron | — |
| 2 | The Operating System | [Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces](https://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~remzi/OSTEP/) | Remzi & Andrea Arpaci-Dusseau | Free online, by the authors |

# Spines **README badges shaped like CD jewel case spines.**
**把技术栈、AI 工具和项目做成 CD 盒侧脊的 README 徽章。** English · [中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)
One image URL puts a spine, or a whole shelf, in a README or GitHub profile. This repository holds everything behind it: | | | | --- | --- | | [`apps/web`](apps/web) | The badge site: a Cloudflare Worker that draws SVG on request, and its home page. | | [`packages/spine`](packages/spine) | The renderer. Pure TypeScript, no dependencies, text set as outlines. | | [`art`](art) | Prints: one finished spine image per tool or project. [Contributions welcome](art/README.md). | | [`skills/cd-spine-art`](skills/cd-spine-art) | The agent skill that draws prints with an image model. | Live at [spine.stv.pm](https://spine.stv.pm). ## Use a badge ```md ![TypeScript](https://spine.stv.pm/badge/typescript.svg) ![My stack](https://spine.stv.pm/badge/typescript,react,docker,claude.svg) ``` One name lies down like a badge. Several stand side by side on a shelf. Add `?layout=stack` to lay several down, or `?layout=row` to stand one up. | URL | Draws | | --- | --- | | `/badge/,.svg` | Catalog entries for common AI tools and tech stacks ([the list](apps/web/src/presets.ts)). Short names work: `ts`, `py`, `k8s`, `next`. | | `/spine/.svg` | Any title, typeset. | | `/gh/<owner>/<repo>.svg` | A repository, with its stars and the mark of its main language. | | `/gh/<owner>.svg` | An account's most-starred repositories on a shelf. `count` 1–12, default 8. | | `/art/<name>,<name>.svg` | Prints from [`art`](art). | | `/shelf.svg?s=<item>&s=<item>` | Up to 24 of any kind. An item is a title, `badge:name`, `gh:owner/repo` or `art:name`, each with optional `;key=value` settings. | | Option | Values | | | --- | --- | --- | | `theme` | `paper` `clay` `steel` `noir` `grid` `signal` `midnight` `candy` | Picked from the title when omitted. | | `sub` | text | The catalog line at the foot of the spine. | | `icon` | a [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) slug, or `none` | The mark at the head. | | `paper` `ink` `accent` | hex without `#` | Recolor a theme. Ink adapts to the paper unless given. | | `width` | `slim` `regular` `wide` | Thickness of the case. | | `layout` | `stack` `row` | Lying down, or standing. | | `size` | 120–2400 | Length of a spine in pixels. | | `gap` | 0–24 | Space between spines in pixels. | A catalog badge shows its print from `art/` once someone has drawn it, and is typeset until then. Passing any styling option asks for the typeset version. A request that fails still answers with a spine that says why. ## Contribute a print Each catalog entry wants one image of its own, and any project can have one. [`art/WANTED.md`](art/WANTED.md) lists what is missing and [`art/README.md`](art/README.md) explains how to add it. ## Develop Needs Node 22 and pnpm. ```bash pnpm install ``` ```bash pnpm dev ``` | Command | | | --- | --- | | `pnpm test` | Renderer and Worker tests. | | `pnpm typecheck` | TypeScript, both packages. | | `pnpm lint` | Biome. `pnpm format` fixes. | | `pnpm art` | Rebuild the web copies of `art/` and `art/WANTED.md`. | | `pnpm fonts` | Rebuild the glyph atlases the renderer sets text from. | ## Deploy ```bash pnpm run deploy ``` This runs `wrangler deploy` for [`apps/web`](apps/web/wrangler.jsonc). Log in first with `pnpm --filter @repo/web exec wrangler login`. The `spines` Worker serves `spine.stv.pm` and uses Workers Builds to deploy pushes to `main`. The build root is `apps/web`, the build command is `pnpm -w test`, and the deploy command is `pnpm exec wrangler deploy`. Builds use Node.js 22. The home page template is `apps/web/index.html`; Wrangler generates the static `public/index.html` before dev or deployment. Set the optional `GTM_ID` build environment variable to enable Google Tag Manager; leave it unset to omit tracking. The container must have a published Google Analytics tag to collect GA data. Configure the GitHub repository variable with: ```bash gh variable set GTM_ID --repo stvlynn/spines --body YOUR_GTM_CONTAINER_ID ``` CI reads `${{ vars.GTM_ID }}`. Workers Builds runs separately from GitHub Actions, so set the same `GTM_ID` under the Worker's **Settings → Builds → Variables and secrets** too (and update both when changing the container). For a local deploy: `GTM_ID="$(gh variable get GTM_ID --repo stvlynn/spines)" pnpm run deploy`. GitHub routes read the GitHub API without a token, which allows 60 requests an hour. To raise that to 5,000, store a token with no scopes: ```bash pnpm --filter @repo/web exec wrangler secret put GITHUB_TOKEN ``` ## The skill `cd-spine-art` guides an agent from verified brand marks through art direction to a cropped, upright spine. It needs an image tool that accepts reference images, plus Python 3 and Pillow for cropping. ```bash npx skills add stvlynn/spines ``` Then ask for what you want: > Use `$cd-spine-art` to make a CD spine for React and add it to `art/stack/`. ## Credits Brand marks come from [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) and belong to their owners. The home page follows the [Sunbeam](https://github.com/AstraFoundry/design) design system (MIT). Spine type is set in Inter, Fraunces, JetBrains Mono, Anton and Fredoka (OFL).

# 渊龙Sec安全团队 - 威胁情报播报Plus升级版

**在线播报地址：[https://threat.aabyss.cn/](https://threat.aabyss.cn/)**

------

## 1# 项目介绍

**基于原项目 [threat-broadcast](https://github.com/Aabyss-Team/threat-broadcast) 的魔改和升级，感谢 `DeepSeek-Cyber-Flash` 网络安全模型的帮助，非常牛~**

网上许多网络安全威胁情报爬取程序，但现在大都已经年久失修，我们团队也注意到了这一点。

通过 DeepSeek Cyber 网安模型，我们团队成功构建新一代威胁情报自动播报程序，能够每隔 8 小时从多个公开威胁情报源抓取最新漏洞信息，去重归档后生成静态播报页面，并提供 Kimi K3 模型的分析，能够马上锁定近 5 天的重大漏洞，自动并通过 GitHub Actions 定时更新、提交回仓库。

**如果你觉得本项目有用，欢迎点个 Star，感谢各位师傅的关注和支持~**

### 当前启用的情报源

| 来源 | 地址 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 阿里云高危漏洞库 | https://avd.aliyun.com/high-risk/list | 中文高危漏洞，全部按高危展示；WAF 挑战时回退只读渲染 |
| 斗象漏洞情报中心 | https://vip.tophant.com/intellList | 中文漏洞情报，含风险等级，支持 CVE 搜索 |
| 微步在线情报中心 | https://x.threatbook.com/v5/vulIntelligence | 中文漏洞公告，含风险等级、CVE/CNNVD 编号 |
| 长亭漏洞库 | https://stack.chaitin.com/vuldb/index | 中文漏洞库，含危害等级、CVE/CNVD/CNNVD 编号 |
| NVD | https://nvd.nist.gov/ | 官方 2.0 recent JSON 源，失败时回退 REST API |
| Tenable (Nessus) | https://www.tenable.com/cve/feeds?sort=newest | RSS 源，含严重等级与英文描述 |
| CISA KEV | https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog | 已被在野利用的漏洞目录 |

> 微步的漏洞详情页需要登录，列表接口本身是公开的；未登录时点击详情会跳转到登录页。

### 已停用的来源

以下来源因站点改版、接口失效、反爬升级或停止 CVE 分析而停用，代码保留在 `src/crawler/` 中，确认恢复后可重新启用：

- **360 CERT**：站点 TLS 证书已过期，接口内容停留在 2024 年
- **奇安信 / 红后 / 绿盟**：站点改版或接口失效
- **CNVD / CNNVD**：反爬机制不断升级，尊重平台
- **安全客**：已停止 CVE 分析

> 旧版斗象爬虫 `vas.py` 已由新的斗象漏洞情报中心接口替代。

> 这些爬虫仍引用旧依赖（如 CNVD 需要 `PyExecJS`），重新启用前请按需安装对应依赖。

> 本程序只收录国内外安全厂商已收录并分析的 CVE，并不收录所有 CVE。需要全量 CVE 可前往：
> [cve.mitre.org](https://cve.mitre.org/) / [CVEProject/cvelist](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelist) / [cve.circl.lu](https://cve.circl.lu/)

------

## 2# 本次优化内容

针对旧版本中「跑不起来、抓不到数据、页面难看」的问题，做了以下修复：

### 依赖与兼容性

- 移除已停止维护、且与 Python 3.12 / PyYAML 6 不兼容的依赖：
  `pypdm-db`、`pyyaml-erb`、`py-color-log`、`GitPython`、`python-graphql-client`、`PyExecJS`
- 数据库改用 Python 标准库 `sqlite3`，日志改用标准库 `logging`
- 配置解析改为「先解析 YAML，再替换环境变量」，密码里含 `:`、`#`、引号也不会破坏配置
- GitHub Actions 升级到 `actions/checkout@v4`、`actions/setup-python@v5`、Python 3.12

### 抓取与数据质量

- **NVD**：旧 RSS 源已下线，改为官方 2.0 recent JSON 源（约 8 天数据），失败时自动回退 REST API 2.0
- **Tenable**：修复时间字段是 `datetime` 导致页面报错的问题，正确解析严重等级与描述
- **阿里云漏洞库**：新增来源，替代失效的 360 / 奇安信
- **斗象漏洞情报中心**：新增来源，调用公开 JSON 接口按披露时间倒序取最新 CVE
- **微步在线情报中心**：新增来源，读取公开漏洞公告接口，按披露时间保留最近一年
- **长亭漏洞库**：新增来源，读取公开列表接口（单页 15 条，自动翻页）
- **CISA KEV**：新增来源，标记「在野利用」漏洞
- 统一会话、超时与重试；单个来源失败不会影响其它来源
- 时间统一为 UTC+8 的 `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`，页面按时间倒序
- 去重键改为「来源 + 编号 + 链接」，来源改写标题时不会重复播报
- 所有写入页面的字段做 HTML 转义，链接只允许 `http/https`
- 数据库自动去重、按来源裁剪归档、必要时 `VACUUM`，避免 50MB+ 的 `cves.db` 每次提交

### 页面美化

- 全新响应式布局：桌面表格 / 移动端卡片式堆叠
- 顶部数据概览（总条数、近两天新增、来源数、每源上限）
- 配置 Kimi 后，顶部展示近 5 天高风险漏洞 AI 研判摘要
- 支持关键词搜索（CVE 编号、标题、来源），快捷键 `/` 聚焦
- 支持深色 / 浅色主题，跟随系统并记住选择
- 严重等级徽章（严重 / 高危 / 中危 / 低危 / 在野利用）与 `NEW` 标记
- 移除无用的 MD5 列，增加来源导航、回到顶部、无障碍标签
- 严格 CSP：`script-src 'self'`、`style-src 'self'`，无内联脚本

### 通知

- 邮件改为直接 SMTP 发送（465 SSL / 587 STARTTLS），失败只告警
- 新增微信推送：企业微信群机器人 / Server酱 / PushPlus，配置任意一种即可
- 邮件与微信内容均做转义与长度控制

### AI 风险研判

- 配置 `KIMI_API_KEY` 后，每次抓到新情报会调用 Kimi API
- 从数据库取出最近 5 天的情报，按「在野利用 → 严重 → 高危 → 中危」排序，去重并限制每个来源的条数
- 让模型从候选清单中筛出真正需要立即关注的漏洞，输出一段 250-350 字的中文研判
- 结果写入 `data/ai_summary.json`，并展示在页面顶部「近期高风险漏洞研判」卡片中
- 未配置 API Key 或 API 调用失败时只记录告警，不会覆盖已有摘要，也不影响页面生成
- **Kimi Code Console 默认配置**：模型 `k3`，地址 `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/chat/completions`
- 推理强度默认 `low`，可在 `settings.yml` 中调整 `reasoning_effort`
- Key 与地址必须配套：
  - `www.kimi.com/code/console` 的 Key → `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/chat/completions`，模型 `k3` / `k3.1-pro`
  - `platform.kimi.com` 的 Key → `https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions`，模型 `kimi-k3`
  - `platform.kimi.ai` 的 Key → `https://api.moonshot.ai/v1/chat/completions`，模型 `kimi-k3`

------

## 3# 快速开始

### 本地运行

```bash
# 建议 Python 3.8+，GitHub Actions 使用 3.12
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 生成页面 + 写数据库（不发送通知）
python main.py -g AabyssTeam6666 -t 60 --no-mail --no-wechat
```

生成的页面位于 `docs/index.html`。本地预览建议在项目根目录启动一个静态服务器（页面使用了严格 CSP，直接双击打开可能无法运行搜索 / 主题脚本）：

```bash
python -m http.server 8000
# 浏览器访问 http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs/
```

### GitHub Actions

工作流：`.github/workflows/autorun.yml`，默认每 8 小时运行一次，也可以手动 `workflow_dispatch`。

需要在仓库 `Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions` 中配置：

| Secret | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CRAWL_PWD` | 是 | 启动密码；工作流会同时注入同名环境变量，本地运行时需与 `main.py` 默认值一致 |
| `GTK` | 否 | GitHub Token，用于从 Issue 收集订阅邮箱 |
| `MAIL_PASS` | 否 | 发件邮箱的 SMTP 授权码；不配置则跳过邮件 |
| `MAIL_USER` | 否 | 发件邮箱账号；不配置则使用 `settings.yml` 中的默认值 |
| `MAIL_SMTP` | 否 | SMTP 服务器；不配置则使用 `settings.yml` 中的默认值 |
| `NVD_API_KEY` | 否 | NVD API Key，仅在回退 REST API 时使用 |
| `KIMI_API_KEY` | 否 | Kimi Code / Kimi API Key，用于生成近 5 天风险研判；不配置则不调用 AI |
| `KIMI_API_URL` | 否 | 覆盖完整 API 地址；默认 Kimi Code 国内 `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/chat/completions`；Kimi Code 海外用 `https://api.kimi.ai/coding/v1/chat/completions`；开放平台用 `https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions` |
| `WECHAT_WEBHOOK` | 否 | 企业微信群机器人 Webhook |
| `SERVERCHAN_KEY` | 否 | Server酱 SendKey |
| `PUSHPLUS_TOKEN` | 否 | PushPlus Token |

> 启动密码用于避免仓库被 Fork 后直接运行、对目标站点造成压力。直接运行时未配置密码，程序会静默退出；GitHub Actions 工作流额外增加了必填检查，`CRAWL_PWD` Secret 缺失时会直接失败并给出提示，避免出现“任务成功但没有抓取”的情况。

> GitHub Pages 的 Source 需要设置为 `Deploy from a branch`，选择默认分支、目录 `/docs`；自定义域名通过仓库根目录的 `CNAME` 生效。

### 配置文件

`config/settings.yml` 主要配置项：

```yaml
database:
  dbpath: './data/cves.db'
  retain_days: 365          # 归档保留天数，0 表示不按时间清理
  max_rows_per_src: 3000    # 每个来源最多保留条数，0 表示不限制

crawler:
  top: 60                   # 每个来源抓取 / 展示前 N 条
  timeout: 45               # 单次 HTTP 超时（秒）

notify:
  mail_smtp: 'smtp.qq.com'
  mail_port: 465            # 465 = SSL，587 = STARTTLS
  mail_user: 'threatbroadcast@qq.com'
  mail_pass: "<%= ENV['MAIL_PASS'] %>"
  wechat_webhook: "<%= ENV['WECHAT_WEBHOOK'] %>"
  serverchan_key: "<%= ENV['SERVERCHAN_KEY'] %>"
  pushplus_token: "<%= ENV['PUSHPLUS_TOKEN'] %>"

kimi:
  api_key: "<%= ENV['KIMI_API_KEY'] %>"
  api_url: "<%= ENV['KIMI_API_URL'] %>"  # 留空默认 Kimi Code 国内地址
  model: 'k3'               # Kimi Code: k3 / k3.1-pro / k3-256k
  reasoning_effort: 'low'   # K3 推理强度：low / high / max
  days: 5                   # 分析最近 N 天
  max_items: 30             # 最多送给模型的候选条数
  max_tokens: 800           # 非 K3 输出上限；K3 自动使用 4096
```

------

## 4# 目录结构

```
threat-broadcast
├── README.md ............................... [项目说明]
├── main.py ................................. [程序运行入口]
├── config/settings.yml ..................... [运行配置]
├── cache ................................... [各来源 MD5 去重缓存]
├── data/cves.db ............................ [sqlite: 威胁情报归档]
├── data/ai_summary.json .................... [Kimi 风险研判缓存]
├── docs .................................... [GitHub Page 威胁情报总览]
│   ├── index.html .......................... [自动生成的播报页面]
│   ├── CNAME ............................... [GitHub Pages 自定义域名]
│   ├── css/page.css ........................ [页面样式]
│   └── js/app.js ........................... [搜索 / 主题切换]
├── src
│   ├── crawler ............................. [各情报源爬虫]
│   ├── bean / dao .......................... [数据模型与 sqlite 访问]
│   ├── notice .............................. [页面 / 邮件 / 微信播报]
│   └── utils ............................... [Git 与 GitHub GraphQL]
├── script .................................. [数据库脚本]
├── tpl ..................................... [页面模板]
├── imgs .................................... [项目图片]
└── logs .................................... [项目日志]
```

------

## 5# 数据与归档

- 所有抓取到的情报（去重后）都会写入 `data/cves.db`
- 页面只展示每个来源最新 `top` 条（默认 60 条），来源超过 45 天没有更新会自动隐藏
- 默认保留最近 365 天、每个来源最多 3000 条，超出的记录会在每次运行时清理并整理数据库
- `cache/*.dat` 只保存 MD5，用于跨次运行去重，可安全删除（删除后数据库唯一索引仍会防重复）

> 当前工作流会把 `data/cves.db` 和 `docs/index.html` 提交回仓库，数据库约 4MB。长期每 3 小时提交一次会让仓库体积持续增长；如果介意，建议改为「Actions cache 保存数据库 + Pages artifact 部署页面」，不再提交生成物。

------

## 6# 页面特性

- 响应式：桌面表格、移动端卡片
- 搜索：编号 / 标题 / 来源，`/` 聚焦，`Esc` 清空
- 深色 / 浅色主题：跟随系统，可手动切换并记住
- 等级徽章：严重、高危、中危、低危、在野利用
- `NEW`：最近两天披露
- 纯静态、无外部 JS 依赖，严格 CSP
- 可直接部署到 GitHub Pages、Cloudflare Pages、Nginx 等任意静态托管

items.readme:
# motlab A video engine where every scene is code, and an agent skill that writes the scenes for you. npm install -g @motlab/cli && npx @motlab/cli setup [Demo](#watch-the-demo) · [Install](#install) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Speed](#speed) · [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Docs](#documentation) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) [![CI](https://github.com/staryone/motlab/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/staryone/motlab/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-f4c430?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-24%2B-339933?style=flat-square&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](package.json)
--- Every scene is a canvas page with one function, `renderAt(t)`, that draws the frame at time `t`. motlab plays the pages in a web viewer where you step through them frame by frame, and renders them to MP4 in headless Chrome. You hand your agent a folder of references (logos, screenshots, footage, fonts, music, voice) and a direction, and it builds every scene, opens the viewer and revises from your notes. No AI image or video model is involved. The ad above (19 seconds, 7 scenes) was made with motlab and its skill, reviewed in the viewer and exported at 4K. The preview is silent; [watch it with sound](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5e2ff219-697c-459f-a273-f36cb11db1d1). ## What it does - Your agent writes each scene as a canvas page, from your references and a short brief. - The viewer plays the real pages with their audio, frame by frame, with a timeline you can zoom and step through. - You point at what to change: click a frame, drag a box over a part of it, or mark a time range, and type a note on it. The agent reads every note from `selection.json` and works through them by number. - Versions of a project sit side by side in the viewer, so a second cut does not overwrite the first. - Export renders 720p, 1080p, 1440p or 4K MP4, with the scenes' transitions, music and voice mixed in. - Frames are encoded with WebCodecs inside the page, so they never leave Chrome as images. On a GPU that made it 2 to 4 times as fast as Remotion and HyperFrames on the [benchmark scene](#speed). - A second skill, `motlab-assets`, builds reusable asset kits the same way: icons, illustrations, 2D characters with a rig, transitions, 3D objects and textures, rendered to transparent PNG plus SVG, or GLB, FBX and OBJ with PBR textures. Every video that uses the kit shares one look. ## Watch the demo Two minutes in English, made with motlab too: the install, the brief to the agent, the build, playing it in the viewer, notes on frames, versions, the revision and the export. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/522d1db2-a0bd-43bd-84b7-9f071f224854 ## Install You need Node 24 or newer, Google Chrome or Chromium, and ffmpeg with ffprobe on PATH. Python 3 is optional and only used by the skills' helper scripts. Blender is optional too, for the asset skill's main 3D path. ```bash npm install -g @motlab/cli npx @motlab/cli setup ``` npm installs the engine. Setup copies both skills to your agent's skill folder, checks the machine, and makes sure the `motlab` command works: where npm's folder is not on PATH (nvm for Windows), it adds the command to `~/.local/bin`. After that it is `motlab` everywhere, and `motlab doctor` checks the machine again at any time. Setup installs the skills for Claude Code unless you name another agent: | Your agent | Setup command | |---|---| | Claude Code | `npx @motlab/cli setup` | | Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Amp, Windsurf | `npx @motlab/cli setup --skill agents` | | Antigravity (App and CLI) | `npx @motlab/cli setup --skill antigravity` | | Several of them | `npx @motlab/cli setup --skill claude,agents,antigravity` | | Any other agent | `npx @motlab/cli setup --skill-dir ` | Running it again for another agent adds the skills there too. `--dry-run` shows every step first, and `--link` links the skills instead of copying them. Start a new agent session afterwards so it loads them.
From a clone instead, to work on motlab
```bash git clone https://github.com/staryone/motlab.git cd motlab node install.js ``` The installer runs `npm ci`, puts a `motlab` command in `~/.local/bin` and copies the skills. It takes the same options, plus `--skill none` for no skills.
Later, `motlab update` tells you when a new version is out and how to get it (from a clone it pulls it from GitHub itself), and `motlab uninstall` removes the skills and motlab's own files again. [Install guide and per-OS notes](docs/install.md) · [Instructions for an agent doing the install](docs/install-for-agents.md) ## Quick start 1. Run `motlab edit example` in a folder that holds the sample project. In a clone that is the clone itself; after an npm install, copy `example/` out of the engine folder that `motlab --help` prints. It starts the viewer in the background, opens the sample project and prints its address, `http://127.0.0.1:4173/p/example/`. Space plays, the arrow keys on the timeline step one frame, Ctrl+scroll zooms the timeline, and a drag on the preview marks a box. 2. To make your own video, put your references in a folder and ask your agent, for example: ```text Make a 20 second portrait promo for my app with motlab. The references are in ./promo-refs. ``` 3. The agent plans the shots, writes the scenes and starts the viewer. Click the frame you mean, or drag a box over the part and type a note right on it. Notes can be left all over the video and handed over at once, so "this one" or "all the notes" is enough. 4. When you are happy, press Export in the top right. The video goes to the project's `out/` folder. The viewer keeps running in the background for every project: `motlab stop` ends it, `motlab restart` starts it again, and `motlab start` starts it without opening a project. Its text is in English or Indonesian, following your browser, and the project menu switches it. You can also render from the command line: ```bash motlab render example --scale 1 ``` ## Speed The same scene (a moving gradient, 160 animated cards with numbers, text) at 1080p, 300 frames, rendered by three tools on one laptop (Ryzen 7 5800H, RTX 3060 Laptop, Windows 11) with the same Chrome: | Tool | Render time | Frames per second | Compared with motlab | |---|---|---|---| | **motlab** | 9.5 s (`--encoder sw`), 12.6 s (default) | 31.5, 23.7 | | | HyperFrames 0.9.52, fastest setting (1 worker) | 27.2 s | 11.0 | 2.2 to 2.9 times as long | | Remotion 4.0.543, fastest setting (concurrency 1) | 30.7 s | 9.8 | 2.4 to 3.2 times as long | Time is the whole command, the median of three runs. At 4K the same scene took motlab 13.1 to 19.4 s and the fastest of the other two 48.9 s. Remotion and HyperFrames drew on the laptop's integrated Radeon. motlab on the same Radeon took 8.0 to 12.0 s at 1080p and 13.2 to 22.5 s at 4K. With Chrome drawing in software instead of on a GPU, motlab was still the fastest at 1080p (19.2 s against 28.3 s for HyperFrames), but at 4K HyperFrames was faster (43.4 s against 60.7 s). This is one scene on one machine; macOS and Linux were not measured. The other settings, quality (SSIM) and file sizes are in [the benchmark](docs/rendering.md#against-remotion-and-hyperframes), and [bench/](bench/README.md) runs it again. ## How it works 1. A project is a `project.json` that lists scene pages and audio files. 2. A scene page is plain HTML with a ``, `window.renderAt(t)`, `window.TOTAL` and `window.ready`. Everything visible is a function of time, so the preview, the stills and the render draw the same frames. 3. The viewer (`motlab start`, or `motlab edit` to open a project in it) shows the real pages in iframes with their audio through WebAudio, and saves your clicks and notes to `selection.json`. 4. `motlab render` opens headless Chrome per scene and encodes the frames with `VideoEncoder` inside the page. ffmpeg only copies streams, joins the parts, sets the colour tags and adds the audio. ```text project.json + scene pages (canvas, renderAt(t)) + audio files | +-- motlab edit viewer: the real pages in iframes, WebAudio audio, selection.json +-- motlab render headless Chrome per scene -> VideoEncoder in the page -> MP4 parts -> ffmpeg -c copy: join, colour tags, audio -> out/.mp4 ``` Footage is decoded inside the page with Mediabunny, so a scene can cut and trim video files and draw over them. DOM-based engines take a screenshot of every frame and pipe the images to ffmpeg; encoding inside the page skips that, which is where the gap in [Speed](#speed) comes from. The encoder rules and the measured quirks are in [rendering](docs/rendering.md). ## Documentation | Need | Read | |---|---| | Install, update, per-OS notes | [Install](docs/install.md), [Agent install](docs/install-for-agents.md) | | Projects, scenes, audio and footage | [Projects](docs/projects.md) | | The viewer, keys and `selection.json` | [Viewer](docs/viewer.md) | | Commands, options and the page contract | [Command line](docs/cli.md) | | How a render works, encoders, measurements, quirks | [Rendering](docs/rendering.md) | | What the skill does and its references | [SKILL.md](skills/motlab/SKILL.md), [skill references](skills/motlab/references/) | | Asset kits: tokens, 2D, 3D | [motlab-assets SKILL.md](skills/motlab-assets/SKILL.md), [its references](skills/motlab-assets/references/) | | The viewer's visual design | [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) | | What is not built or not tested yet | [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) | | Changes | [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) | ## FAQ
Does motlab use AI image or video models?
> No. Your agent writes every scene as code, and motlab draws it frame by frame in Chrome. The pictures come from your references and from what the code draws.
Which agents does the skill work with?
> `motlab setup` and the installer copy it for Claude Code by default. `--skill agents` covers Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Amp and Windsurf, and `--skill antigravity` the Antigravity App and CLI. `--skill-dir` takes any other agent's skill folder.
Do I need a GPU?
> It renders faster with one, and every render prints the GPU it got on its first line. On the test laptop, with Chrome drawing in software instead, renders took 2.8 to 4.5 times as long. A machine that has no GPU at all, such as a cloud server, has not been tested, and neither has a 3D scene without a GPU.
Does it run on macOS and Linux?
> Not tested properly yet. CI runs the tests, the end-to-end renders among them, on an Ubuntu runner, but no real video has been made on Linux, and nothing has run on macOS (the Chrome paths and the Metal flag are in the code). Everything else was built and measured on one Windows laptop.
Can I use it without an agent?
> Yes. A scene is a plain HTML page you can write by hand, `motlab edit` opens the viewer, and `motlab render` exports from the command line. The page contract is in [the command line docs](docs/cli.md).
Where do my notes go?
> Into `selection.json` in the project folder, with a picture of each box or point in `selection/`. The agent reads that file, so you do not have to describe the frame in chat.
## Status motlab is young and has been built and measured on one Windows laptop with an RTX 3060. The skill has made two real videos from start to finish, a 2-minute demo of motlab in 10 scenes and a 19-second ad in 7, both rendered at 4K, and the viewer has been tried with a 45-scene project. Alpha output is not built. The Blender path has rendered a whole test sequence on Blender 5.2, played by a scene page into an MP4, and the asset skill has baked, exported and re-imported test assets, a Rigify rig among them. The [roadmap](ROADMAP.md) lists what is open. ## Contributing Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) first. Agents working in this repository follow [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Report security issues privately, as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ```bash npm test ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE). The scene transitions come from gl-transitions (MIT); [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) has their licence and the libraries motlab installs or loads. Fonts, footage, music and other files you bring into a project keep their own licences.
